pokedexEntries.bk: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

pokedexEntries.wh: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

pokedexEntries.y: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

pokedexEntries.as: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

pokedexEntries.su: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

pokedexEntries.mo: As soon as it finds a male to be its partner, the beautiful flower on its head darkens, droops, and withers away.

pokedexEntries.us: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.

pokedexEntries.um: It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

pokedexEntries.sw: It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.

pokedexEntries.sh: Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers have a sublime scent, but they’re also staggeringly expensive.
